//vite: vite is pinned EXACTLY, not with a caret, and that is load-bearing. site/buildguard.ts installs a build.rollupOptions.onwarn that recognises vite's 'has been externalized for browser compatibility' warning and regexes the importer out of the English sentence — vite carries it in no structured field.
